the RS braneworld scenario is not a realistic candidate for a string theory motivated model.
the hierarchy problem is not solved in the braneworld scenario.

the hierarchy problem in string theory is not solved by the RS braneworld scenario, even if one takes into account the full stringy bulk.
the fine-tunings are not just a feature of the original RS model, but are rather a general feature of string inspired braneworlds.
the hierarchy problem in the braneworld scenario is not solved by the presence of the dilaton and the Kalb-Ramund field.
